name: Creepyville
about: Our own small foggy town where every CreepyCartoonTales story happens: old houses, one clock tower, a lake, a forest, a closed amusement park. Same town, same places, every day; it grows by itself.

locations.town_square_night: the town square at night, an old stone clock tower showing nearly three o'clock, closed shops with dark windows, wet cobblestones, fog, one flickering street lamp
locations.main_street_day: a small-town main street on a grey afternoon, old shop fronts with plain blank awnings and no signs, parked cars, power lines, autumn leaves on the pavement
locations.police_station_night: the outside of a small-town police station at night, two police cars parked in front, blue and red light reflecting on wet ground, a lit glass door
locations.police_station_inside: inside a small-town police station at night, a front desk with an old computer, a bench, a notice board, a flickering ceiling light, an empty corridor to the cells
locations.school_hallway_night: an empty school hallway at night, rows of metal lockers, one locker door slightly open, emergency exit light glowing green, a long shiny floor
locations.classroom_day: a school classroom on a rainy afternoon, wooden desks, a chalkboard, a clock on the wall, a window with rain
locations.park_night: a town park at night, empty swings, a pond reflecting the moon, a bench under a lamp post, tall dark trees, mist on the grass
locations.park_day: a sunny town park, green grass, a pond with ducks, benches, a winding path, a small fountain, cheerful but slightly too quiet
locations.playground_night: an empty children's playground at night, a slide, a roundabout, one swing still moving, a single lamp, fog
locations.parking_lot_night: a large outdoor car park at night, many parked cars in rows, tall lamp posts with orange light, puddles, one car's headlights on
locations.gas_station_night: a lonely roadside gas station at night, glowing canopy lights, two fuel pumps, a small shop with a neon window, empty road, forest behind
locations.diner_night: inside a 24-hour roadside diner at night, red booths, a long counter with stools, a coffee pot, a window showing the dark empty road
locations.supermarket_aisle_night: a supermarket aisle late at night, long shelves of colourful products, harsh white lights, one light flickering at the far end, no people
locations.hospital_corridor_night: a hospital corridor at night, pale green walls, a wheelchair by the wall, doors with small windows, a flickering tube light at the end
locations.graveyard_night: an old graveyard at night, leaning gravestones, a twisted tree, an iron gate, a full moon, low fog over the grass
locations.old_church_night: an old wooden church on a hill at night, a tall bell tower, broken stained glass glowing faintly, a gravel path, crows on the roof
locations.forest_path_night: a narrow path through a dark pine forest at night, moonlight beams through the trees, mist, roots across the path
locations.lake_dock_night: a wooden dock on a calm black lake at night, a small rowing boat tied up, the moon reflected in the water, forest on the far shore
locations.amusement_park_night: a closed old amusement park at night, a tall wooden roller coaster loop against the sky, a dark ferris wheel, ticket booth, string lights half broken
locations.train_station_night: a small empty train station platform at night, a bench, a station clock, rails disappearing into fog, a single yellow lamp
locations.bus_stop_night: a bus stop on an empty road at night in the rain, a glass shelter with a timetable, a street lamp, reflections on the wet road
locations.library_night: inside an old town library at night, tall wooden shelves, a reading table with a green lamp, moonlight from a high window, dust
locations.basement_night: a cluttered house basement, a bare light bulb hanging from a cord, a boiler, old boxes, wooden stairs going up into darkness
locations.attic_night: a dusty attic under a sloped roof, old trunks, a rocking chair, a round window with moonlight, cobwebs
locations.elevator_inside: inside an old apartment elevator, metal walls, a panel of buttons, a flickering ceiling light, the doors closed
locations.rooftop_night: the flat rooftop of an apartment building at night, water tanks, an antenna, the lights of the town below, a cloudy sky with the moon
locations.bridge_fog_night: an old iron bridge over a river at night, thick fog, lamp posts fading into the mist, no cars
locations.barn_night: an old red farm barn at night, the big door half open, hay bales, a lantern glowing inside, a cornfield behind
locations.laundromat_night: Rows of circular washing machines hum beneath flickering green fluorescent tubes, casting eerie aquatic reflections across soapy checkered linoleum in a silent, liminal haze.
locations.greenhouse_fog_day: An overgrown Victorian glass solarium tangled with enormous potted monsteras and suspicious hanging vines, illuminated by milky overcast daylight diffusing through cracked glass panes with humid, comic suspense.
locations.antique_shop_day: Pale shafts of sunlight cut through floating dust motes onto cluttered shelves packed with grandfather clocks, bizarre music boxes, and silent porcelain figurines.
locations.bowling_alley_night: Flickering neon signs and purple blacklight cast eerie glows across empty polished lanes, where a single glowing pin waits at the end of the shadowy floor.
locations.costume_shop_day: Dusty afternoon sunlight filters through tall front windows onto rows of quirky rubber monster masks, hanging witch hats, and eerie wooden mannequins in a cluttered store.
locations.indoor_pool_night: An empty indoor swimming pool with cracked teal tiles, eerie green underwater lighting casting rippling shadows on the wet deck, and a faint mist rising in the quiet dark.
locations.mini_golf_fog_night: An eerie outdoor mini-golf course shrouded in thick fog, illuminated by glowing fiberglass monster obstacles and flickering green spotlights.
locations.planetarium_night: A dark domed planetarium interior projecting strange purple constellations across the ceiling over shadowy rows of empty plush seats.
locations.corn_maze_fog_day: A claustrophobic dirt path winding through tall, withered cornstalks under a hazy daylight sky, filled with eerie stillness.
locations.arcade_night: A dim retro video arcade bathed in buzzing neon pink and cyan light, with glowing game cabinets casting spooky flickering shadows.
locations.drive_in_theater_night: An overgrown gravel lot studded with rusted audio speaker poles beneath a colossal blank screen glowing with faint blue static in the heavy evening mist.
locations.wax_museum_day: A silent carpeted hall lined with brass stanchions and uncanny, smiling wax figures bathed in dramatic overhead spotlights under dusty skylights.
locations.radio_station_night: An empty soundproof broadcast studio glowing under a pulsing red ON AIR sign, with vintage boom microphones suspended over an illuminated mixing console and soundboards.
locations.dentist_office_day: A clinical pastel-mint examination room where blinding pale daylight filters through half-closed blinds onto an empty reclining chair under an ominous circular overhead lamp.
locations.sewer_tunnel_night: An eerie underground brick tunnel dimly illuminated by flickering lanterns, featuring damp stone paths and mysterious glowing green mist.
locations.fortune_teller_tent_night: Inside a cozy carnival tent lined with dark purple velvet curtains, illuminated by glowing crystal globes and swirling magical fog.
locations.car_wash_tunnel_night: A narrow drive-through car wash tunnel where dripping foam brushes and heavy rubber curtains dangle over reflective wet concrete, illuminated by eerie pulsing cyan and magenta neon lights.
locations.taxidermy_shop_day: A dusty antique curiosity shop lined with empty mahogany pedestals and glass bell jars, where dramatic slanting stripes of afternoon sunlight cut through closed window blinds.
locations.treehouse_fog_night: A rickety wooden treehouse perched in a gnarled dead oak tree, glowing with a faint warm lantern inside while cold blue moonlight cuts through thick swirling ground fog.
locations.lost_and_found_office_day: A cramped, dusty municipal backroom stacked to the ceiling with unlabeled boxes, crooked wire hangers, and weird unclaimed heirlooms under the hum of dull yellow fluorescent tubes.
locations.cul_de_sac_fog_day: A suburban dead-end street shrouded in thick morning fog, surrounded by identical pastel houses with unnervingly still lawns.
locations.boiler_room_night: A shadowy underground chamber packed with rumbling rusty pipes, glowing crimson gauge lights, and sudden bursts of mysterious steam.
locations.tanning_salon_night: An empty indoor salon lined with open futuristic tanning pods glowing in eerie ultraviolet purple light, creating a surreal sci-fi horror atmosphere.
locations.pumpkin_patch_fog_day: A misty outdoor field overgrown with twisting vines and unnaturally lumpy oversized pumpkins beneath a pale daylight sky, casting a spooky autumn mood.
locations.motel_reception_night: A gloomy retro motel lobby with peeling floral wallpaper and vintage key racks behind a dark wooden desk, lit only by a flickering yellow lamp that casts spooky shadows.
locations.pet_shop_day: An eerie indoor pet store lined with stacked empty glass aquariums and birdcages, bathed in pale morning light filtered through dusty windows and glowing green neon lights.
locations.video_store_night: A retro VHS rental store at night, illuminated by flickering green neon light casting long eerie shadows across aisles of colorful tape cases.
locations.roller_rink_fog_night: An indoor retro roller-skating rink covered in swirling low purple fog, with glowing disco ball reflections bouncing off dark hardwood floors.
locations.clock_tower_interior_night: Giant rusty iron gears and a heavy swinging pendulum dominate this dusty timber tower room illuminated by eerie moonlight filtering through a massive translucent clock face.
locations.sauna_fog_day: Thick fragrant steam fills a wooden cedar room lit by a soft orange corner light, with empty tiered benches surrounding a glowing bucket of hot volcanic stones.
locations.lighthouse_room_night: A circular watchroom atop a creaky coastal tower, illuminated by the sweeping beam of a giant spinning glass lens cutting through pitch-black fog.
locations.ice_rink_fog_day: An eerie, abandoned indoor ice skating rink shrouded in thick ground fog beneath cold, flickering fluorescent lights.
locations.trampoline_park_night: A vast indoor arena of interconnected bouncy floor mats and foam pits bathed in eerie ultraviolet blacklight and dim neon green exit glows, echoing with hollow silence.
locations.mirror_maze_night: A dizzying labyrinth of polished full-length mirrors creating endless receding corridors illuminated only by faint teal floor strips and disorienting magenta neon accents.
